guitarist_1.name: Guitarist
dialog: The cliffs all round this city keep the wind off.
Best place in Sinnoh to play outdoors, if you ask me. Listen to that echo!

pokefan_m.name: Man
dialog: Been to the Department Store yet?
You could spend a whole day in there and still not see every floor.

battle_girl_1.name: Girl
dialog: Maylene, our Gym Leader, trains harder than anybody in this city.
One day I'm going to fight just like her!

lady.name: Lady
dialog: I popped into the Department Store for one little thing.
And here I am with a dozen bags. It happens every single time!

battle_girl_2.name: Girl
dialog: See those big rocks at the east end of town? They fell from the sky, ages and ages ago.
Meteorites! The whole city grew up around them.

roughneck_1.name: Tough Guy
dialog: That big building at the north end of town belongs to Team Galactic.
New energy for everyone, they say. Funny how you never see anyone go in or out.

guitarist_2.name: Guitarist
dialog: The Game Corner's right here. Win some coins, and the shop next door swaps them for prizes.
Me? I'm saving up for a new set of strings.

roughneck_2.name: Tough Guy
dialog: Everyone in this city is training at something.
Even my old gran does press-ups on the doorstep every morning.

battle_girl_3.name: Girl
dialog: Through the gate to the south is Route 214, and past that, Lake Valor.
There's a very grand hotel by the lake. One day I'll stay there!

guitarist_3.name: Guitarist
dialog: This city is one big dojo. Even I do sit-ups between songs.
The Gym's just along the street, if you're feeling brave.
